$comment: Our Care hierarchy = the folder structure of 'Website Content - Suhad/Our Care' (5 Oct 2026): hub -> 4 services -> sections -> programmes (up to 4 levels under /care). title/desc = the page title and lead line of each document; a child's card text (desc, cardTitle) comes from its PARENT's document where that lists it (Inpatient / Outpatient main pages, the programme lists of the section pages), else from the child's own lead line. Slugs: from the live site URLs quoted in the documents where given (care, inpatient, outpatient, pediatric-rehab, pulmonary-rehab, physical-medicine-rehab-care, pediatric-care, physiotherapy, occupational-therapy, speech-language-therapy, cerebral-palsy-program); home-healthcare and in-school from the live site's home / Our Care page links (WordPress export, 6 Oct 2026); live site /ae and /sa URLs confirmed by the client's bug 058 (8 Oct 2026): mechanical-ventilation (+ weaning-program, long-term-ventilated-care), post-acute-rehab (+ neuro-rehab, post-surgical-rehab, road-traffic-accident-rehab), long-term-care-rehab (+ pediatric-long-term-care); the other section / programme slugs are derived from the titles and UNCONFIRMED (docs/open-decisions.md CT2, U58). image = the Figma Inpatient Care card photos (83:226) for the six sections that had them; children without a photo render as text cards. Full page text: src/data/content/care/<slug>.en.json (+ <slug>.<region>.en.json for a region variant: home-care.sa). Paediatric Care (pediatric-rehab) has no document in the folder: generated from its card (CT3). Arabic service titles / card text = the live site's Arabic Our Care and home pages (WordPress export pages 19115 / 19153); the sections and programmes have no Arabic in the export. regions (optional) = the countries that offer a service (bug 047, 7 Oct 2026): In-School Care = UAE only (the live site has it under /ae/care/in-school only). Absent = every edition. Outpatient programmes and Paediatric Pulmonary Rehab are also UAE-only on the live site: to confirm with the client before tagging them (docs/open-decisions.md). icon (9 Oct 2026) = the programme card's icon: a ConditionCards name (neuro / musculoskeletal / post-surgical / accident, the Figma post-acute icons) or an image key under src/assets (care/icons/*, the client's programme icons). Bug 075 (9 Oct 2026, docs/open-decisions.md R053): section / programme titles and the five Paediatric programme card texts now have Arabic, copied from each page's own Arabic content file (content/care/<slug>.ar.json hero title / text = the live Arabic page, same English), Paediatric Care (inpatient) = the identical English title of the Outpatient Paediatric Care page (الرعاية للأطفال). Section card titles that differ from the page title (Post Acute Care, Long Term Care, Physical Medicine Care) and the section card texts still have no Arabic.
